title: D3: paper titles and unitless INSUNITS
description: D3, spec section 4 steps 1 and 3: the paper TEXT on each new layout, then INSUNITS 0 (no op accepts unitless; both fix.units and doc.setup take only real units). Run last of the planting jobs: after INSUNITS 0 the engine refuses every op except fix.units and doc.setup.

args.code:
(progn
 (vl-load-com)
 ((lambda ( / doc ms lays res try bylayer setprops mkline mkpline paperblock ptext)
   (setq doc (vla-get-ActiveDocument (vlax-get-acad-object))
         ms (vla-get-ModelSpace doc)
         lays (vla-get-Layouts doc)
         res nil)
   (defun try (tag fn / r)
     (setq r (vl-catch-all-apply fn nil))
     (setq res (cons (list tag (cond ((vl-catch-all-error-p r) (strcat "FAILED: " (vl-catch-all-error-message r)))
                                     (r "ok")
                                     (T "FAILED: returned nil"))) res)))
   (defun bylayer (o)
     (vla-put-Color o 256) (vla-put-Linetype o "ByLayer") (vla-put-Lineweight o -1) o)
   (defun setprops (o lay props)
     (vla-put-Layer o lay) (bylayer o)
     (foreach p props (vlax-put-property o (car p) (cadr p)))
     o)
   (defun mkline (lay p1 p2 props)
     (setprops (vla-AddLine ms (vlax-3d-point p1) (vlax-3d-point p2)) lay props))
   (defun mkpline (lay pts closed width / flat o)
     (foreach p pts (setq flat (append flat (list (car p) (cadr p)))))
     (setq o (vla-AddLightWeightPolyline ms (vlax-make-variant (vlax-safearray-fill (vlax-make-safearray vlax-vbDouble (cons 0 (1- (length flat)))) flat))))
     (vla-put-Closed o (if closed :vlax-true :vlax-false))
     (vla-put-ConstantWidth o width)
     (setprops o lay nil))
   (defun paperblock (name) (vla-get-Block (vla-Item lays name)))
   (defun ptext (layout str x y h style lay / o)
     (setq o (vla-AddText (paperblock layout) str (vlax-3d-point x y 0.0) h))
     (vla-put-StyleName o style)
     (vla-put-Layer o lay)
     (bylayer o))
   (try "text-A-102" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-102" "FLOOR PLAN" 2.0 2.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "text-A-103" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-103" "FLOOR PLAN" 2.0 2.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "text-A-104" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-104" "FLOOR PLAN" 2.0 2.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "text-A-105" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-105" "FLOOR PLAN" 2.0 2.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "text-A-106" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-106" "FLOOR PLAN" 2.0 2.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "text-A-107" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-107" "FLOOR PLAN" 2.0 2.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "text-A-108" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-108" "FLOOR PLAN" 2.0 2.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "text-A-109" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-109" "FLOOR PLAN" 2.0 2.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "text-A-110" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-110" "FLOOR PLAN" 2.0 2.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "text-A-111" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-111" "FLOOR PLAN" 2.0 2.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "text-A-112" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-112" "FLOOR PLAN" 2.0 2.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "text-A-113" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-113" "FLOOR PLAN" 2.0 2.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "text-A-114" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-114" "FLOOR PLAN" 2.0 2.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "text-A-115" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-115" "FLOOR PLAN" 2.0 2.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))

   (try "INSUNITS-0" (function (lambda () (progn (setvar "INSUNITS" 0) (= (getvar "INSUNITS") 0)))))
   (reverse res))))
